summary: Fresh screenshot and static implementation review found no unresolved high/critical visual defect blocking the bounded synthetic connected read-only workbench.
observations: The connected capture contains no visible pairing code, bearer capability or credential field. Its repeated synthetic/read-only labels clearly distinguish this fixture from real project or account data.

Page title, connection section, session context, transcript speakers and tool summary form a legible hierarchy. The approximately 770px reading column, consistent section spacing, restrained surfaces and 448px preview fit the desktop capture without overlap or clipping.
Connection status, Refresh and Disconnect are distinguishable. Tool completion is accompanied by explicit text; the preview is identified as a fixed synthetic fixture.

Static CSS uses fluid widths, wrapping controls, a single pairing column below 600px and stacked header at 360px. The inspected narrow-screen test checks document overflow at 320, 390 and 1280px. These support bounded responsive acceptance, not a complete visual audit of all viewport/state combinations.
Static implementation clears the code field and state before the pairing request, removes the form in the connected state, and passes interactive=false to the synthetic LinkPreview.
review_boundary: Final synthetic connected read-only workbench only, against plan revision 11 and the registered design/client contracts. This is a bounded design gate, not parent product completion.
evidence_limits: Direct visual evidence is one 1280x956 connected-state PNG; no new browser interaction, test execution, service startup or implementation changes were performed.

The coordinator reports 14 passing Chromium E2E tests including the narrow-screen preview case, 31/31 focused React tests, and a passing fresh Chromium capture check. Those outcomes were supplied evidence, not independently rerun here.

Narrow-screen acceptance is supported by current CSS and the reported test; this reviewer did not view a separate narrow screenshot. Keyboard behavior, screen-reader announcements, measured contrast, zoom and other connection/error states are not certified by this capture.
No full ChatGPT vendor fidelity, runtime accessibility certification, authentication/security proof, OS isolation, parent BB scenario completion or overall product completion is claimed.

Plan and contract file SHA-256 values were independently checked. Source, environment and verification bindings were accepted exactly from the coordinator; screenshot-to-source freshness is coordinator provenance, not independently reconstructed.

provenance.method: Fresh independent child review: visual inspection of provided capture plus read-only current source/spec inspection; no prior review judgment reused.
provenance.report_schema_reference: Read only the top-level field names of design-review-r2.json; did not consume its findings or verdict.
